name: Sophie Nakamura
psychographics: Loves the 'set and forget' model; dislikes having to manage multiple subscriptions for different needs.
current_solutions: Relies on a combined 'Oxfam Unwrapped' gift subscription for household items and the 'Woolworths' app for 'pickup and go' meals.
frustration: Last Thursday at 5:50 PM, the 'Woolworths' 'pickup and go' lane was closed for 'stocktake,' and because she hadn't pre-booked a slot, she spent 20 minutes circling the car park during rush hour, arriving home at 6:15 PM exhausted before cooking.
decision_style: Prefers one-stop apps; will abandon a brand if it requires more than two taps to reorder.
voice: Casual and slang-heavy. Uses Australianisms like 'arvo,' 'heaps,' and 'no dramas.' Frequently uses filler sounds like 'umm' and 'like.'
